name: Battery
description: A battery outline that fills from left to right, ideal for charging states

variations.name: default
variations.description: An outlined battery charges up as the level sweeps from empty to full in a loop

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the loader container in pixels

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the loader container in pixels

props.name: strokeColor
props.description: Color of the battery outline and terminal

props.name: backgroundColor
props.description: Fill color of the battery interior

props.name: isAnimating
props.description: Controls whether the animation runs. Set to false to pause animation.
